# SYNC

> A real-time multiplayer party game about matching your group's instincts.

Canonical public runtime: https://sync-party-game.mcgill-raylene.workers.dev/

## Public surfaces
- Homepage: https://sync-party-game.mcgill-raylene.workers.dev/
- Chat Edition: https://sync-party-game.mcgill-raylene.workers.dev/chat/
- Sitemap: https://sync-party-game.mcgill-raylene.workers.dev/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://sync-party-game.mcgill-raylene.workers.dev/crawlers.json

## Machine-facing policy
- Public indexing, citation, and user-directed retrieval are allowed.
- Model training and bulk harvesting are not granted.
- `/api/`, `/control-room*`, and `/usage*` are not public discovery surfaces.
- Crawling permission is not authentication, authorization, execution authority, or permission to access private data.
